rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Error Ontology
rdf:Description.dc:creator: Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Error Ontology
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Ciccarese, P., & Peroni, S. (2014). The Collections Ontology: creating and handling collections in OWL 2 DL frameworks. Semantic Web, 5(6), 515-529. DOI: https://doi.org/10.3233/SW-130121.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has error
rdf:Description.vann:example: :my-resource error:hasError "This resource violates a constraint of the model."^^xsd:string .
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A description, usually in natural language, of which kind of error results from a resource.
rdf:Description.skos:note: A data property linking a resource that contains a logical error (which results in it belonging to the class `owl:Nothing`, therefore making the model inconsistent) to a textual description of that error.
